items.description: Upgrade to premium carbon frame (elective, bicycle recovered undamaged)
items.rationale: Policy 3.1.6, 7.1.8(c): The frame upgrade is an elective improvement, not caused by the insured event. The recovered bicycle was undamaged, so no indemnity for upgrades or elective replacements.

items.description: Brake replacement as part of routine service
items.rationale: Policy 3.1.6, 7.1.8(a): Routine service and replacement of undamaged parts is not indemnified. No damage to brakes from the theft event.
Policy 3.1.6, 7.1.8(a): General servicing and tune-up is maintenance, not repair of insured damage. Not indemnified.
Policy 7.1.8(b): Shipping is only indemnified if it relates to covered repair or recovery. Here, it is for elective work and not for recovery or repair of insured damage.
Policy 7.1.8(f): Vehicle costs are only indemnified if required for covered repair or recovery. Here, they relate to elective work and are not indemnified.
Policy 7.1.8(a): Assembly for elective upgrades or maintenance is not indemnified. No insured damage to repair.
Policy 7.1.8(a): Labour for elective or maintenance work is not indemnified. No insured damage.
Policy 7.1.8(a): Labour for elective or maintenance work is not indemnified. No insured damage.

Policy 5.2.2(a), 7.1.7(g): This is a necessary recovery cost to regain possession of the stolen bicycle. Indemnified, but subject to the EUR 500 mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2) in aggregate with other recovery costs.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock to release bicycle
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.2(b): Cutting the lock is a necessary recovery cost for the stolen bicycle. Indemnified, but subject to the EUR 500 mobility equipment sub-limit in aggregate with other recovery costs.
Policy 5.2.2(b), 7.1.7(d): Labour for the recovery of the stolen bicycle is indemnified, subject to the EUR 500 mobility equipment sub-limit in aggregate with other recovery costs.
